capabilities.name: open_page
capabilities.description: Open one of the app pages.

capabilities.name: open_group
capabilities.description: Open a group's page by its name.

group.description: The group name as the user said it.

capabilities.name: open_friend
capabilities.description: Open a friend's page, with what you owe each other, by their name.

friend.description: The name as the user said it.

capabilities.name: get_balances
capabilities.description: Who owes the user and whom the user owes: each friend and each group with a balance. Use for "who owes me", "what do I owe", "my balance".

capabilities.name: add_group_expense
capabilities.description: Add an expense the user paid in one of their groups, split equally between all its members. Ask for the amount and what it was for if missing.

group.description: The group name as the user said it.

amount.description: In the group currency, e.g. 300 or 45.50.

capabilities.name: add_friend_expense
capabilities.description: Add an expense or a loan with one friend, outside any group. paid_by: who paid. split "equal" halves it; "all" means the one who did not pay owes the whole amount (a loan, e.g. "I lent Abebe 500").

friend.description: The name as the user said it.

capabilities.name: record_payment
capabilities.description: Record that the user paid someone back. It waits until that person confirms it. Name a group only if the debt is in that group.

person.description: The name as the user said it.

group.description: Only when the user names a group; omit for a personal payment.

capabilities.name: record_received
capabilities.description: Record that someone paid the user back. It counts at once. Name a group only if the debt is in that group.

person.description: The name as the user said it.

group.description: Only when the user names a group; omit for a personal payment.

capabilities.name: remind_friend
capabilities.description: Send a payment reminder to a friend who owes the user money.

friend.description: The name as the user said it.

capabilities.name: send_friend_request
capabilities.description: Send a friend request to someone on ABRO, found by name or username.

capabilities.name: create_group
capabilities.description: Create a new group and invite friends to it. They join when they accept. Currency is birr.

capabilities.name: add_group_member
capabilities.description: Invite a friend to one of the groups the user is an admin of.

group.description: The group name as the user said it.

friend.description: The friend to invite, by name.

capabilities.name: group_balances
capabilities.description: Who is owed and who owes in one group.

group.description: The group name as the user said it.

capabilities.name: who_pays_next
capabilities.description: Whose turn it is to pay the group's next bill, in order.

group.description: The group name as the user said it.

capabilities.name: ekub_status
capabilities.description: Where the user stands in an ekub: this round's turn, what they pay and receive, and when their own turn comes. Name the ekub if they have several.

capabilities.name: search_expenses
capabilities.description: Find expenses by words in their name (e.g. "fuel"), and/or in one group, and/or with one friend. Use for "what did we spend on…", "show the taxi expenses".

text.description: Words to look for in the expense name.

group.description: A group name, if the user named one.

friend.description: A friend name, if the user named one.

capabilities.name: recent_activity
capabilities.description: The latest expenses and payments the user is part of.

capabilities.name: explain_balance
capabilities.description: Explain where the balance with one friend comes from: the total, and the latest expenses and payments between you.

friend.description: The name as the user said it.
